title: Operations Internship in Chennai, Bangalore
jobDescription: Are you a proactive and enthusiastic individual looking to gain hands-on experience in operations management? Let'sTransport is seeking a dynamic Operations Intern to join our team. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our operations team and gain valuable insights into the logistics industry. Key Responsibilities Include Assisting with day-to-day operations tasks Monitoring and updating data in MS-Excel Communicating with clients/vendors Supporting the team in optimizing logistics processes Providing administrative support to the operations team Assisting in the coordination of shipments Contributing to the overall efficiency and success of the operations department If you are a detail-oriented individual with strong MS-Office skills and proficiency in English and any 2 regional languages, this internship is perfect for you. Apply now and kickstart your career in operations management with Let'sTransport! About Company: LetsTransport was founded in 2015 by IIT-Kharagpur alumni. It is a series-B funded, last-mile tech-logistics solution provider for intra-state deliveries based in Bangalore. It offers reliable, affordable, and professional services, structured to serve enterprises. LetsTransport aggregates light commercial vehicles for urban logistics and have onboarded 55,000+ truckers on its platform across 14 cities.
